scope: bounded interface diagnostic only; no screening, candidate construction, import, or final event

claims.statement: The anonymous public search route accepts q plus repeated type values and exposes event, paired contribution/subcontribution, attachment, event_note, and category UI result groups.

In the tested event group, implicit and quoted satellite-space queries returned one ID; AND and NOT returned explicit zero; OR, parentheses, and tested symbolic forms did not return the atomic-result union. Field-like title: and description: syntax returned zero.
Because direct Boolean partitions cannot be losslessly represented by the observed search behavior, ESA Indico requires local harvest rather than direct translations.

Search pages in the bounded contribution and attachment tests held ten records, exposed next/previous cursor values, retained total=-1 for nonzero result groups, and repeated the first ordered IDs after a short interval.

The source's normal contribution UI group must send contribution and subcontribution together in this diagnostic: each type alone returned explicit zero while the paired request returned contribution records.

First-page results were equal for MBSE/mbse and CubeSat/cubesat, cube-sat differed from cube sat, and nanosat* was only first-page-equal to nanosat; these observations do not validate a source-wide expansion or wildcard.

untested: Full-result equality for case, phrase, stemming, lemmatization, wildcard, and automatic-expansion behavior.
